孔子.parts: 孔 (his family name) + 子 master
孔子.note: Classical 子, 孔子, 夫子.

说.note: Classical 曰. In the Analects 說 is usually yuè, "delight" (1.1).

在.note: Classical 於. Before a verb it means "in the middle of doing".

的.g: 's, of; links a description to its noun
的.note: Classical 之. With no noun after it, "the one that…" (classical 者): 聪明的 "the clever ones".

地方.note: Classical 處, 里. Also "point, respect": 不对的地方 "where they are wrong".

才.note: Classical 乃, 始. "A 才 B": B happens only when A does.

好.note: Same as your card. "To like" (classical 好 hào) is now 喜欢.

怎么.note: Classical 焉, 何, 惡乎.

聪明.parts: 聪 sharp hearing + 明 bright sight
聪明.note: Classical 知 (read 智) in 焉得知.

呢.note: Does the work of classical 乎, 哉 at the end of a rhetorical question.

没有.g: not have; there is no; did not
没有.note: Classical 無, 未. 没 negates 有 and past events; 不 negates everything else.

长久.parts: 长 long + 久 long time
长久.note: Both are in your cards: 久處約, 長處樂 (4.2).

地@ly.g: -ly; turns the words before it into an adverb, before a verb
地@ly.note: The same character as 地 dì "ground". Classical has no marker here: 久處 "long stay".

过.note: Classical 過 is "pass by" and "a fault". 过日子: "get through one's days".

也.note: False friend. Classical 也 is the full stop "that's how it is". Classical "also" is 亦.
known: full stop: that's how it is

了.g: (done); the action is complete, or things have changed
了.note: Loosely classical 矣. After a verb: the action is complete. At the end of a sentence: "now it is so".

安心.g: at ease, with a mind at rest
安心.parts: 安 at peace + 心 heart

去.note: False friend. Classical 去 is "leave" (去仁). Modern "leave" is 离开.

只有.parts: 只 only + 有 there is
只有.note: Classical 唯. "只有 A 才 B": only A can B.

讨厌.parts: 讨 ask for + 厌 fed up
讨厌.note: Classical 惡 (wù). 厌 is your 厭.

真的.note: Classical 苟 packs 如果真的 "if really" into one word.

立志.parts: 立 set up + 志 aim

就.note: Classical 則, 斯. "如果 A 就 B": if A then B.

会.g: will; be likely to; know how to
会.note: Classical leaves "will" unsaid, or uses 將.

和.note: Classical 與. Joins nouns; before a person, "with".

是.note: False friend. Classical 是 means "this"; classical says "A, B 也" with no verb.

用.g: use; with, by means of; use (noun)

正当.note: Classical 以其道 "by its proper way".

君子.note: The same word as in the Analects.

没钱.parts: 没 not have + 钱 money

离开.parts: 离 part from + 开 away

连.note: "连 A 也不 B": not B even for A.

顿.note: After a number, modern nouns need a counter: 一顿饭 "one meal". Classical just says 一食.

时间.note: Classical 間 (終食之間). Both characters are in your cards.

时候.note: Classical 時. "X 的时候": when X.

困难.parts: 困 hemmed in + 难 hard

比.note: Classical puts 於 after the adjective. In your cards 比 is "side by side" (4.10).

更.note: "比 A 更好": even better than A.

事.note: In your cards 事 is the verb "serve" (4.18). The noun is the everyday sense now.

让.note: Classical 使. False friend: classical 讓 is "yield" (4.13 禮讓).

到.note: After a verb: the action reached its target (听到 hear, 得到 get).

有人.parts: 有 there is + 人 person

里.note: False friend. Classical 里 is "village" (里仁).

把.g: (taking); moves the object in front of the verb
把.note: "把 A 用在 B 上": take A and use it on B. Loosely classical 以.

上.g: on, above (after a noun); in the matter of

吗.g: (yes/no question); turns a statement into a question

known: full stop: that's how it is

各有各的.parts: 各 each + 有 has + 各的 each one's

真理.note: Stands for classical 道 "the Way" here.

读书人.parts: 读 read + 书 book + 人 person

追求.note: Classical 志於 "set one's aim on".

穿.note: Classical 衣, used as a verb.

得@c.g: (how well:); links a verb to how well or how much
得@c.note: 穿得不好 "dress badly". Not the classical 得 "get".

很.note: Often just glue before an adjective.

丢人.parts: 丢 lose + 人 (face before others)

讨论.parts: 讨 look into + 论 discuss

怎样.note: "怎样 A 就怎样 B": whatever way is A, do B that way.

想.note: Classical 思, 欲; in 4.11 懷 "cherish".

道德.parts: 道 the Way + 德 virtue

小人.note: The same word as in the Analects.

为了.g: for the sake of, in order to

礼让.note: Classical 禮讓, unchanged. Here 让 keeps its classical sense, "yield".

来.g: come; (before a verb) in order to
来.note: "用 A 来 B": use A to do B.

管理.parts: 管 control + 理 put in order

礼.note: Your card 禮, in its mainland form.

有没有.g: whether one has; is there or not
有没有.parts: 有 have + 没有 not have
有没有.note: Verb + not-verb is how modern Chinese asks "whether".

站得住.parts: 站 stand + 得 can + 住 hold
站得住.note: Classical 立. Verb + 得 + result is "can"; with 不 it is "can't" (做不到).

别人.note: Classical 人 (as in 人不知).

啊.g: (ah); warms or softens what is said, or calls to someone
啊.note: Does the work of 乎 in 參乎.

连起来.parts: 连 link + 起来 up, together

问.note: Your card 問, in its mainland form.

意思.note: 何謂也 "what does it mean?" is now 这是什么意思.

恕.g: putting oneself in the other's place

检查.parts: 检 inspect + 查 look into

他们.parts: 他 he + 们 (plural for people)

再.g: again; (再 A 也 B) however A, still B

远.note: Your card 遠, in its mainland form.

为@for.note: Classical 為 read wèi. Not 为 wéi "be, do".

长.note: Your card 長, in its mainland form.

而.g: and so; (为 A 而 B) do B because of A
而.note: Straight from classical. Modern keeps it in set frames.

做不到.parts: 做 do + 不 not + 到 reach
做不到.note: Classical 不逮 "not come up to".

仁德.note: Classical 仁. Modern Chinese prefers the two-character word.

项目.note: In SCP files, the anomalous object itself.

收容.parts: 收 take in + 容 hold

措施.parts: 措 arrange + 施 carry out
措施.note: 施 is in your cards (己所不欲，勿施於人).

该.note: Formal written style, from old official documents. Everyday 该 is "ought to" (应该).

于.note: Classical survivor: your card 於/于. After a verb: 收容于 "held at".

透明.parts: 透 pass through + 明 bright

中.g: in, inside (after a noun); in the course of
中.note: The formal partner of 里. Classical 中.

未.note: Classical survivor, same as your card. Everyday speech: 没.

经.note: 未经许可 "without going through permission".

此.note: Classical survivor, unchanged. Everyday speech: 这.

配备.parts: 配 fit out + 备 prepare

模因.note: A sound loan: mó-yīn imitates "meme". Words like this cannot be read from their characters.

护目镜.parts: 护 protect + 目 eye + 镜 lens

对@to.note: Puts the target before the verb: 对该项目的实验 "experiments on the item". Classical 於.

及.note: Classical survivor. Everyday speech: 和. 及以上 "and above".

以上.g: and above, more than; the above

审批.parts: 审 examine + 批 sign off

描述.note: 述 is in your cards (述而不作).

为.note: Classical survivor: your card 為. Everyday speech: 是. Read wèi, it means "for".

制.note: After a material: 红木制 "made of rosewood".

刻板.note: Usually 刻板 means "rigid, stereotyped"; here it is literal.

其.note: Classical survivor, same as your card. Everyday speech: 他的, 它的.

小篆.parts: 小 small + 篆 seal script
小篆.note: The script standardised under the Qin, about 220 BC.

非礼勿言.g: "what is contrary to ritual, do not say"
非礼勿言.parts: 非 not + 礼 ritual + 勿 don't + 言 speak
非礼勿言.note: Analects 12.1: 非禮勿視，非禮勿聽，非禮勿言，非禮勿動.

个.note: After a number, or after 这 and 每, modern nouns need a counter: 每个字样.

约.note: In your cards 約 is "restraint, hardship". "Roughly" is the common modern sense.

大小.note: Two opposites make the abstract noun: "big-small".

以.g: with, by means of; in order to
以.note: Classical survivor, same as your card.

进行.note: Official padding before a verb-noun: 进行填充 "carry out filling" is just "fill".

可.note: Same as your card. Everyday speech: 可以, 能.

观察.parts: 观 look at + 察 examine
观察.note: 观 is your 觀 (觀過).

后.g: after (follows a time or an event)

者.note: Classical survivor, same as your card: 受影响者 "the one affected".

一开始.g: at first, at the very start

产生.parts: 产 produce + 生 be born

下.note: 在…下 "under…": 在监护下 "under guard".

准则.note: 则 is your 則, in its noun sense "rule".

视而不见.g: look without seeing; turn a blind eye
视而不见.parts: 视 look + 而 yet + 不 not + 见 see
视而不见.note: A classical phrase used whole. The Great Learning: 心不在焉，視而不見.

拒绝.parts: 拒 resist + 绝 cut off

无法.g: unable to, have no way to
无法.parts: 无 have no + 法 way

所有.parts: 所 that which + 有 exists
所有.note: "All that there is": the classical 所 + verb.

出.g: out (after a verb: the action brings something out)

厌恶.parts: 厌 fed up + 恶 hate
厌恶.note: Both are in your cards. 恶 here is 惡 read wù, "hate".

使.note: Same as your card (不使不仁者加乎其身).

内.g: within (after a span of time or a place)

腐朽.note: 朽 as in Analects 5.10: 朽木不可雕也.

已.note: Same as your card. Everyday speech: 已经.

与.note: Classical survivor: your card 與, in its mainland form. Everyday speech: 和, 跟.

根据.g: according to, on the basis of
根据.parts: 根 root + 据 base on

等.note: After a list or an example: 书写等方式 "writing and other means".

时.g: when, at the time of (after a clause)
时.note: Classical 時. Everyday speech: …的时候.

自.note: Classical survivor, same as your card. Everyday speech: 从.

相隔.g: be separated by (a time, a distance)

天.note: In your cards 天 is "heaven". "Day" is the everyday modern sense.

但.note: The short form of 但是.

实施.parts: 实 real + 施 carry out

若.note: Classical survivor. Everyday speech: 如果.

因.note: Classical survivor. Everyday speech: 因为. 因 A 而 B: "B because of A".

推断.parts: 推 reason out + 断 judge

导致.parts: 导 lead + 致 bring about

缺乏.parts: 缺 lack + 乏 short of

备注.parts: 备 for reference + 注 note

晨.g: Chen (a surname here; the word means "morning")

发出.parts: 发 send out + 出 out

艰涩.g: laboured, rough (of a sound or of writing)

含混.parts: 含 hold in + 混 muddled

终.g: end (here the first half of 终于 "at last", broken by gasps)

鲜血.note: 鲜 is your 鮮 "rare", in its other sense, "fresh".

是否.g: whether; is it so or not
是否.note: The formal yes/no question: 你是否有… "do you have…?"

摇.note: 摇了摇头 "shook his head": a verb doubled around 了 is a brief action.

口型.g: the shape of the mouth (mouthing a word)

由.note: 由安保人员提供 "provided by the security staff".

注意.parts: 注 fix on + 意 mind

有所.parts: 有 have + 所 that which
有所.note: Formal: 有所异常 "there is something abnormal".

美好.note: 美 is in your cards (里仁為美).

发声.parts: 发 send out + 声 sound

根本.note: 根本不是 "is not … at all".

应有.g: proper, that one ought to have

罪恶.note: 恶 is your 惡, here read è.

将@ba.g: (taking); the formal 把: puts the object before the verb
将@ba.note: 将笔掷向… "take the pen and throw it at…".

间.g: room (after a word naming its use)
间.note: 观察间 "observation room". Your card 間 "interval".

壁挂式.parts: 壁 wall + 挂 hang + 式 style

扩音器.parts: 扩 expand + 音 sound + 器 device
扩音器.note: 器 is in your cards (君子不器).

愤怒.note: 愤 is your 憤 (不憤不啟).

起来.note: 嘶吼起来 "began to howl"; 折叠起来 "fold up".

从.note: Classical 自. Your card 從 is "follow" (4.18); "from" is the common modern sense.

之后.parts: 之 of that + 后 after

某些.parts: 某 a certain + 些 some

阅读.parts: 阅 look over + 读 read

继续.parts: 继 continue + 续 carry on

尽力.parts: 尽 use up + 力 strength

折叠.parts: 折 bend + 叠 pile up

没什么.parts: 没 not have + 什么 anything

敏感.note: 敏 is your 敏 "quick" (敏於行).

打断.parts: 打 strike + 断 break off

无论如何.g: no matter what, in any case
无论如何.parts: 无论 regardless + 如何 how
无论如何.note: 如何 is classical "how"; 无 is your 無.

好吧.parts: 好 good + 吧 (softens: agreement, suggestion)

撕碎.parts: 撕 tear + 碎 broken bits

成.note: 揉成球 "crumple into a ball". Your card 成 "complete".
